The Pamukis Approach

Interiors with character, purpose and timeless style.

Pamukis Interior Design is a Nairobi-based interior design business dedicated to transforming everyday spaces into beautiful, functional environments.

From the first concept to the final detail, we combine creative direction, careful space planning, quality finishes and practical execution.

We work across homes, offices, hospitality and commercial environments, tailoring each project to the client's vision and budget.

Pamukis
What We Do

Complete Interior Solutions

One design partner from concept to completion.

01 / DESIGN

Interior Design

Concept development, mood boards, colour schemes, material selection, space planning and furniture layouts.

02 / DETAIL

Gypsum & Ceilings

Feature ceilings, modern gypsum profiles, concealed lighting, recessed details and decorative ceiling solutions.

03 / FINISH

Wall & Floor Finishes

Premium tiling, wall panels, feature walls, paint finishes and coordinated surface treatments.

04 / BESPOKE

Custom Joinery

Kitchens, wardrobes, TV units, vanities, storage and bespoke cabinetry designed for your space.

05 / LIGHT

Lighting & Styling

Layered lighting concepts, decorative fixtures and finishing touches that create atmosphere and balance.

06 / TRANSFORM

Renovation & Fit-Out

Complete interior renovations and commercial fit-outs with coordinated finishes and professional execution.
